test.create_query: CREATE TABLE correlated_exists_outer (k Int64, c1 Int64, c2 Int64, c3 Int64, c4 Int64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
CREATE TABLE correlated_exists_inner (k Int64, c1 Int64, c2 Int64, c3 Int64, c4 Int64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO correlated_exists_outer SELECT number, rand64(1) % 10, rand64(2) % 10, rand64(3) % 10, rand64(4) % 10 FROM numbers_mt(10000000)
INSERT INTO correlated_exists_inner SELECT number, rand64(5) % 10, rand64(6) % 10, rand64(7) % 10, rand64(8) % 10 FROM numbers_mt(10000000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM correlated_exists_outer AS a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM correlated_exists_inner AS b WHERE a.k = b.k AND a.c1 = b.c1 AND a.c2 = b.c2 AND a.c3 = b.c3 AND a.c4 = b.c4) SETTINGS collect_hash_table_stats_during_joins = 0 FORMAT Null
